posts.title: Building an Agent Sandbox from Scratch in Python
posts.description: Two years ago I built a container runtime in Python . That post ended with a list of what the runtime lacked: no user namespaces, no seccomp, no capability dropping. posts.title: How Claude Opus 5.5 Made a Stop-Motion Docker Explainer in 38 Minutes
posts.description: Someone on Reddit shared a prompt for making animated explainer videos with Claude. I tried it with a topic I know well, Docker containers.
